prompt: Implement Pricing module in plain Java+Vavr project with service-per-use-case pattern

assertions.name: service_per_use_case_pattern
assertions.description: Separate service classes per use case (ApplyDiscount, ActivatePriceList) like PublishProductService/ArchiveProductService

assertions.name: vavr_either_returns
assertions.description: Aggregate behavior methods return Either<String, Event> like Product.publish()/archive()

assertions.name: no_lombok_used
assertions.description: No Lombok imports or annotations; manual equals/hashCode/constructors

assertions.name: money_reused_not_recreated
assertions.description: Uses import from pl.shop.catalog.Money, does not create new Money class

assertions.name: productid_reused_not_recreated
assertions.description: Uses import from pl.shop.catalog.ProductId, does not create new ProductId class

assertions.name: all_building_blocks_present
assertions.description: All 8 building blocks from DesignDoc have corresponding Java classes

assertions.name: discount_percentage_validation
assertions.description: Discount constructor validates percentage between 0 and 100 (rule-3)

assertions.name: package_private_internals
assertions.description: PriceEntry entity is package-private (not public), following Product/Enrollment pattern
